en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style view of a historic European riverside city. In the foreground a wide river is crossed by an old multi‑arched stone bridge that carries a metal truss structure on top. On the far bank stands a dense cluster of traditional townhouses climbing a hill. Dominating the right side on the hilltop is a large fortified complex with towers and a tall church spire, resembling a castle or former monastery. The urban fabric and architecture indicate a Central European town. A handwritten number, likely from the negative or publisher, appears at the lower edge.
